hints.title: Hour Digit Constraints
hints.text: The first hour digit can be 2 only if the second hour digit is in {?, 0, 1, 2, 3}; otherwise it must be 1.

hints.title: Second Hour Digit
hints.text: If the second hour digit is hidden, it can be 3 if first digit is 2, or 9 if first digit is 0 or 1.

hints.title: Minute Digits
hints.text: The tens minute digit can be at most 5, and the units minute digit can be at most 9.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; string has fixed length 5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles hour prefix interdependency without missing edge cases.
